wins.text: Q2 total revenue hit a record $15B, up 20% YoY, all organic growth with no acquisition benefit vs. prior year
AI semiconductor revenue reached $4.4B in Q2, up 46% YoY — 9th consecutive quarter of strong growth; AI networking surged 170%+ YoY and held at ~40% of AI revenue
Q2 adjusted EBITDA of $10B (67% margin), up 35% YoY and above 66% guidance; infrastructure software operating margin expanded to ~76% from 60% a year ago
VMware/VCF adoption: 87%+ of top 10,000 customers now on VCF, driving 25% YoY infrastructure software revenue growth to $6.6B, above $6.5B outlook
Repurchased $4.2B (~25M shares) of common stock in Q2 opportunistically; paid $2.8B in dividends

risks.text: Non-AI semiconductor revenue of $4B was down 5% YoY; industrial segment down sequentially; recovery described as 'slow' and 'close to the bottom'
Q3 gross margin guided down ~130 bps sequentially due to higher XPU mix, which carries lower margins than the rest of the portfolio
Export control environment described as 'very dynamic' with Hock explicitly stating he cannot give comfort on future impact — 'rules are changing quite dramatically'

Gross principal debt remains elevated at $67.8B post-quarter-end repayment; free cash flow as % of revenue continues to be pressured by VMware acquisition-related interest expense and higher cash taxes
XPU revenue described as 'lumpy' by analysts; networking outperformance in Q2 raised questions about whether XPU was softer than expected, creating visibility uncertainty on mix

guidance_items.detail: Q3 consolidated revenue guided to ~$15.8B, up 21% YoY; above Q2 record of $15B
Q3 AI semiconductor revenue guided to $5.1B, up 60% YoY — 10th consecutive quarter of growth; total semiconductor revenue ~$9.1B, up 25% YoY
Q3 infrastructure software revenue guided to ~$6.7B, up 16% YoY, above Q2's $6.6B
Q3 consolidated gross margin expected down ~130 bps sequentially due to higher XPU mix; adjusted EBITDA guided at least 66%
Non-GAAP tax rate for Q3 and FY2025 remains at 14%

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Export control / regulatory risk on AI semiconductors — Hock did not proactively address this in prepared remarks and admitted significant uncertainty when pressed
NVLink Fusion / UALink competitive ecosystem threat to Broadcom's scale-up Ethernet networking position
Whether the 4 XPU prospects contribute meaningfully to FY2026 growth — management declined to comment on prospects in prepared remarks
